capabilities.title: Canonical parser syntax
capabilities.summary: The native parser accepts canonical modules, bindings, functions, control flow, and expression forms used by the runnable subset.

capabilities.title: Typed semantic flow
capabilities.summary: Semantic analysis preserves the typed integer and boolean flow used by the runnable subset.

capabilities.title: Canonical semantic rejection
capabilities.summary: Unsupported or invalid language forms are rejected through parser or semantic diagnostics; no switch enables retired forms.

capabilities.title: Strict runtime dispatch lowering
capabilities.summary: Lowering reports unresolved runtime-dispatch linkage through the strict behavior matrix fixture.

capabilities.title: IR module emission
capabilities.summary: IR generation emits the basic module shape used by the runnable native fixture set.

capabilities.title: Runtime dispatch strict diagnostic
capabilities.summary: Runtime dispatch unresolved-symbol behavior is exercised as a strict executable diagnostic. Runtime-owned diagnostic codes and messages come from the strict result surface.

capabilities.title: Runnable smoke path
capabilities.summary: The end-to-end native smoke fixture compiles and runs through the behavior matrix command.

capabilities.title: Async and actor runtime closure
capabilities.summary: Async, task, and actor syntax and runtime concepts remain unavailable unless an entry is separately marked implemented here.

capabilities.title: Native compiler module decomposition
capabilities.summary: The native compiler target graph is decomposed into explicit lexer, parser, semantic, lowering, IR, IO/JSON, pipeline, artifact, runtime, frontend, and driver modules, with include-sharded ownership split across compiler, runtime, pipeline, artifacts, and IO owner surfaces. This is implementation ownership evidence, not a public language behavior claim.

capabilities.title: Public C runtime dispatch result surface
capabilities.summary: The public C runtime API owns image registration, selector lookup, checked i32 dispatch results, the narrow plain i32 lowering entrypoint, and testing snapshots through the strict runtime public headers. It exposes no alternate dispatch mode.

capabilities.title: npm objc3c workflow bridge
capabilities.summary: The only package script is objc3c, which routes npm bridge actions into scripts.objc3c_workflow. Action names, validation tiers, backend descriptions, pass-through behavior, guarantee owners, registry views, handler integrity checks, request dispatch, and direct-entrypoint import roots live under scripts/objc3c_workflow; retired registry facades and package-script alias surfaces are not support claims.

capabilities.title: JSON and schema registry helpers
capabilities.summary: The capability matrix schema, evidence map, native objc3c_json module, and artifact schema registry own deterministic support truth. Publicly replayable evidence commands are npm-bridge commands only.
